name: photoshop-mcp-imt
display_name: Photoshop-MCP-IMT + SKILLS — Photoshop for AI agents
description: Drive a running Adobe Photoshop from your AI agent — every Adobe UI language, a large skills library, built for Photoshop's generative features.
long_description: Photoshop-MCP-IMT by Immersive Media Technologies. 135 Photoshop tools behind a 10-tool facade plus the Photoshop agent skill (ps_skill: generative tools, partner models and credits, retouch, selection, batch, gotchas), a UXP bridge that keeps answering while Photoshop shows a dialog, headless corner-pin, honest errors, no telemetry. Works with every UI language Adobe ships, comes with a large skills library and is built for Adobe's generative features (Generative Fill, Generative Expand, Generative Upscale, text to image, Firefly and partner models, generative credits). Built for localized Photoshop, not just English. Requires Adobe Photoshop 2024+ running on this computer. Apache-2.0 license; unofficial, not affiliated with Adobe Inc.

facade.title: Compact tool surface (10 tools)
facade.description: On: the model sees ps_catalog / ps_do and 8 helpers (~900 tokens) and reaches every operation through ps_do. Off: all 135 tools (125 photoshop_* plus the ps_* helpers) are listed directly.

uxpBridge.title: UXP bridge (second transport)
uxpBridge.description: Start the local bridge for the Photoshop-MCP-IMT Bridge panel plugin (127.0.0.1:38452, shared-secret token). Needs the plugin installed in Photoshop — see the README.

uxpPrefer.title: Prefer UXP for reads, save and export
uxpPrefer.description: Try the UXP plugin first for state / layers / save / export, ExtendScript second. Off: ExtendScript first, UXP only when Photoshop is modal.

photoshopPath.title: Photoshop install path
photoshopPath.description: Optional. Leave empty to auto-detect Photoshop in /Applications or Program Files.
